projects.title: HoosThere: AI Crisis Line Agent
projects.description: An AI voice agent that answers crisis-line calls that would otherwise go unanswered, plus a dashboard for human counselors to review transcripts, AI-extracted notes, severity, and repeat-caller history. I built the speech signal-processing algorithm that detects energy peaks to locate words in call audio (driving the synced transcript and waveform), ran sentiment analysis on calls with Snowflake, and developed the AI voice agent models.
technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, ElevenLabs, Gemini, Snowflake, Signal Processing

projects.title: System Modeling Application for IoT
projects.description: Web app for modeling navy systems: create systems, upload SysML/CSV data, visualize as graphs, and export to SysML. Built with Django (backend), React (frontend), and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: RSI Focused Ortholinear Keyboard
projects.description: Constructed an STM32 custom keyboard with firmware in C and QMK with C++ to reduce impact of repetitive strain injuries
technologies: C, C++, Autodesk Fusion, KiCad, QMK, Hardware Design

projects.title: Solar System Modeling Software
projects.description: Built a MatLab project to simulate the motion of planets and moons in a solar system. Tried multiple methods including Eulers Method and ODE45 to solve the differential equations of motion.
